command:
set -euo pipefail
cd /tmp

echo "== GROMACS writes an XTC trajectory; MDTraj reads it, MDAnalysis cross-checks =="
# GROMACS produces a compressed .xtc of rigid-water MD (spc216 + tip3p ship in the package,
# zero staging). MDTraj reads that GROMACS format -- neither MDAnalysis recipe covered XTC --
# and recovers structure; MDAnalysis reads the SAME file independently. Two unrelated parsers
# agreeing on a computed geometry from the same bytes is the cross-code move (RAxML/IQ-TREE)
# applied to trajectory parsing, on top of the decode-statistic move.
GRO=/opt/conda/share/gromacs/top/spc216.gro
printf '#include "amber99sb-ildn.ff/forcefield.itp"\n#include "amber99sb-ildn.ff/tip3p.itp"\n[ system ]\nwater\n[ molecules ]\nSOL 216\n' > topol.top
printf 'integrator = md\nnsteps = 50\ndt = 0.002\ncutoff-scheme = Verlet\ncoulombtype = cut-off\nrvdw = 0.9\nrcoulomb = 0.9\nconstraints = h-bonds\nnstxout-compressed = 10\n' > md.mdp
cp "$GRO" spc216.gro
gmx_mpi grompp -f md.mdp -c spc216.gro -p topol.top -o t.tpr -maxwarn 5 > grompp.log 2>&1
gmx_mpi mdrun -s t.tpr -deffnm out -nsteps 50 > mdrun.log 2>&1

python3 - <<'EOF' > smoke-check.txt || { cat smoke-check.txt; exit 1; }
import sys, numpy as np
import mdtraj as mdt
import MDAnalysis as mda
from MDAnalysis.lib.distances import calc_bonds
fail=[]
def check(l,ok,detail):
    print(f"{l:26s} {detail}")
    if not ok: fail.append(l)
# MDTraj reads GROMACS xtc + gro topology
t=mdt.load("out.xtc", top="spc216.gro")
check("mdtraj_atoms", t.n_atoms==648, f"{t.n_atoms}  want 648 (216 waters x 3)")
check("mdtraj_frames", t.n_frames==6, f"{t.n_frames}  want 6 (50/10 + t=0)")
check("mdtraj_box_nm", abs(float(t.unitcell_lengths[0,0])-1.8621)<1e-3, f"{float(t.unitcell_lengths[0,0]):.4f}  want 1.8621 nm (spc216 box)")
dmt=float(mdt.compute_distances(t,[[0,1]])[0,0])   # O-H1 water1, frame0, nm
# MDAnalysis reads the SAME file
u=mda.Universe("spc216.gro","out.xtc")
check("mda_atoms", len(u.atoms)==648, f"{len(u.atoms)}  want 648")
check("mda_frames", len(u.trajectory)==6, f"{len(u.trajectory)}  want 6")
u.trajectory[0]; dma=float(calc_bonds(u.atoms.positions[0],u.atoms.positions[1]))/10.0
# physical + the two-reader cross-check
check("distance_physical", 0.09<dmt<0.11, f"{dmt:.5f} nm  want ~0.0956 (O-H)")
check("two_reader_agree", abs(dmt-dma)<1e-6, f"|MDTraj {dmt:.6f} - MDAnalysis {dma:.6f}| < 1e-6 nm (same file, 2 parsers)")
if fail: print("FAILED: "+", ".join(fail)); sys.exit(1)
EOF
cat smoke-check.txt
echo "SMOKE CHECK PASSED"
